hypothesis.statement: In the first 20 active Pangaea decisions, replacing a repeated cooldown-bound outbound protected-partner alliance request with the unchanged selector's offered low-risk neutral expansion improves mirrored placement, survival, or final tiles without protected-partner harm.

guards: pressure and territorial-collapse behavior remain exact-parent
replacement must be an offered non-high-risk neutral expansion
zero harmful action against protected partners
zero unexplained holds or rejected decisions
no rerun after a declared cell produces a valid replay

pass: cu1 reaches in every eligible cell
candidate wins at least 3 of 4 mirrored pair comparisons
aggregate candidate final tiles exceed parent
planner counts are zero in both arms
fallbackUsed and llmPlannerDegraded are false in deterministic mode
reject: planner use or degradation in the deterministic gate
